text:
maya: Heads-up — after today's staged rollout (seed slice) we're seeing a spike of 503s on hosted inference. Got a few customer escalations about timeouts and errors in the last 8m.
support-bot: Alert created: INC-2026-3247 — 503 error rate > 7% for /v1/generate on prod-us-west. Pager sent to #incidents and oncall.
oncall-sre: Looking. Can you paste a simple repro curl and a snippet of the gateway logs? Any recent config flips?
maya: Repro (hit from our test harness):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-open-7b","inputs":"hi"}' -v
```
Logs: `2026-03-17T14:02:11Z ERROR gateway proxy.go:241 upstream error: connection reset by peer; status=503 model-serve-3`
kevin: Canary config `routing.seed_enabled=true` was toggled during the rollout to force the seed variant. That flag accidentally routed 100% of seed slice to a variant missing a new auth header adapter. Oops.
nate: Confirmed. The canary was supposed to be 10% but the matrix swap had a bad condition. I can roll the seed back.
oncall-sre: Before rollback — can you check model-serve-3 health? `kubectl -n rwd get pods -l app=model-serve-3` and `kubectl logs -c inference` — if replicas are OOMing we might need to scale down traffic first.
maya: model-serve-3 pods look healthy, no OOM. Errors are auth failures from upstream: `401 token missing` in the inference adapter logs. Looks like the new variant expects `x-rwd-auth-v2` header which the gateway didn't inject for that routing tag.
kevin: Plan: immediate rollback of routing flip and revert `routing.seed_enabled` to false for the seed slice. Nate, can you run rollback and patch the canary matrix to include header shim?
nate: Running rollback now: `redwoodctl rollout rollback --slice=seed --to=stable-20260317 --reason='auth header shim missing'`
(30s later) nate: rollback CLI returned success. Pushing 10s maintenance rule to shed seed traffic: `rwdctl route update --slice=seed --percent=0`
jess: Support: opening status page note and notifying customers who reported failures. Also adding a billing note — some requests were retried causing doubled token counts for affected customers; need to track usage delta and flag for billing ops.
oncall-sre: Metrics check — 60s after rollback 5xx rate dropping from 7.4% -> 1.2%. Latency back to baseline.
maya: Confirming: errors trending down, customer lanes reporting fewer timeouts. Leaving monitoring on for 30m.
kevin: Follow-up action items: 1) revert canary matrix change and add unit test that validates header shim for variant routes; 2) add a pre-rollout check that simulates one request to each variant; 3) postmortem with timeline and billing impact.
jess: I've filed a support ticket to bill-ops and linked INC-2026-3247, attaching the replay logs.
maya: Thanks all — will keep this open until stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
